from pathlib import Path
import re

path = Path("src/renderer/web-api.js")
text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def replace_once(old, new, label):
    global text
    if old not in text:
        raise RuntimeError(f"web-api patch missing: {label}")
    text = text.replace(old, new, 1)


replace_once(
    '        attendanceEnabled: Boolean(row.attendance_enabled)\n',
    '        attendanceEnabled: Boolean(row.attendance_enabled),\n        deleted: Boolean(row.deleted_at)\n',
    "department deleted flag"
)

count = text.count('        hiddenFromToolbar: Boolean(row.hidden_from_toolbar),\n')
if count < 3:
    raise RuntimeError(f"web-api patch expected 3 toolbar mappings, got {count}")
text = text.replace(
    '        hiddenFromToolbar: Boolean(row.hidden_from_toolbar),\n',
    '        hiddenFromToolbar: Boolean(row.hidden_from_toolbar) || Boolean(row.deleted_at),\n        deleted: Boolean(row.deleted_at),\n'
)

replace_once(
    '        role: normalizeRole(row.role)\n',
    '        role: normalizeRole(row.role),\n        deleted: Boolean(row.deleted_at)\n',
    "member deleted flag"
)

replace_once(
    '    const leaveItems = (state.leaves || []).filter((item) => item?.id && item?.code);\n',
    '    const leaveItems = (state.leaves || []).filter((item) => item?.id && item?.code && !item?.deleted);\n',
    "active leave sync"
)
replace_once(
    '    const overtimeItems = (state.overtime || []).filter((item) => item?.id && item?.name);\n',
    '    const overtimeItems = (state.overtime || []).filter((item) => item?.id && item?.name && !item?.deleted);\n',
    "active overtime sync"
)
replace_once(
    '    const members = Array.isArray(state.members) ? state.members.filter((member) => member?.code && member?.name) : [];\n',
    '    const members = Array.isArray(state.members) ? state.members.filter((member) => member?.code && member?.name && !member?.deleted) : [];\n',
    "do not recreate deleted members"
)

replace_once(
    '    const departments = Array.isArray(state.departments) ? state.departments : [];\n    const shifts = Array.isArray(state.shifts) ? state.shifts : [];\n    const leaves = Array.isArray(state.leaves) ? state.leaves : [];\n    const overtime = Array.isArray(state.overtime) ? state.overtime : [];\n',
    '    const departments = Array.isArray(state.departments) ? state.departments.filter((item) => !item?.deleted) : [];\n    const shifts = Array.isArray(state.shifts) ? state.shifts.filter((item) => !item?.deleted) : [];\n    const leaves = Array.isArray(state.leaves) ? state.leaves.filter((item) => !item?.deleted) : [];\n    const overtime = Array.isArray(state.overtime) ? state.overtime.filter((item) => !item?.deleted) : [];\n',
    "save active master rows only"
)

leave_pattern = re.compile(
    r'    const keptLeaveIds = leaves\.map\(\(item\) => item\.id\);\n'
    r'    const existingLeaveMap = await fetchRowsById\("set_leave"\);\n'
    r'    const removedLeaveRowIds = getRemovedRowIds\(existingLeaveMap, keptLeaveIds\);\n'
    r'    await clearScheduleEntriesByForeignIds\("leave_type_id", removedLeaveRowIds, \{.*?\n'
    r'    \}\);\n'
    r'    await deleteRowsNotIn\("set_leave", keptLeaveIds\);\n'
    r'    const leaveMap = await fetchRowsById\("set_leave"\);',
    re.S
)
text, n = leave_pattern.subn('    const leaveMap = await fetchRowsById("set_leave");', text, count=1)
if n != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("web-api patch missing leave hard-delete block")

overtime_pattern = re.compile(
    r'    const keptOvertimeIds = overtime\.map\(\(item\) => item\.id\);\n'
    r'    const existingOvertimeMap = await fetchRowsById\("set_overtime"\);\n'
    r'    const removedOvertimeRowIds = getRemovedRowIds\(existingOvertimeMap, keptOvertimeIds\);\n'
    r'    await clearScheduleEntriesByForeignIds\("overtime_type_id", removedOvertimeRowIds, \{.*?\n'
    r'    \}\);\n'
    r'    await deleteRowsNotIn\("set_overtime", keptOvertimeIds\);\n'
    r'    const overtimeMap = await fetchRowsById\("set_overtime"\);',
    re.S
)
text, n = overtime_pattern.subn('    const overtimeMap = await fetchRowsById("set_overtime");', text, count=1)
if n != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("web-api patch missing overtime hard-delete block")

replace_once(
    '    await deleteRowsNotIn("set_shift", shifts.map((shift) => shift.id));\n    const shiftMap = await fetchRowsById("set_shift");\n',
    '    const shiftMap = await fetchRowsById("set_shift");\n',
    "shift hard delete"
)
replace_once(
    '    for (const member of state.members || []) {\n',
    '    for (const member of (state.members || []).filter((item) => !item?.deleted)) {\n',
    "skip deleted member writes"
)

replace_once(
    '    const scheduleEntries = [];\n    Object.entries(state.schedule || {}).forEach(([key, slot]) => {\n',
    '    const scheduleEntries = [];\n    const preservedScheduleKeys = new Set();\n    Object.entries(state.schedule || {}).forEach(([key, slot]) => {\n',
    "preserved schedule keys"
)
replace_once(
    '      const member = (state.members || []).find((item) => item.id === parsed.memberId);\n      const profile = member ? profileMap.get(member.code) : null;\n      if (!profile?.id) {\n        return;\n      }\n',
    '      const member = (state.members || []).find((item) => item.id === parsed.memberId);\n      if (member?.deleted) {\n        if (isUuid(parsed.memberId)) preservedScheduleKeys.add(makeScheduleEntryKey(parsed.memberId, parsed.workDate));\n        return;\n      }\n      const profile = member ? profileMap.get(member.code) : null;\n      if (!profile?.id) {\n        return;\n      }\n',
    "preserve deleted employee schedule"
)
replace_once(
    '    const savedScheduleKeys = new Set(scheduleRows.map((row) => makeScheduleEntryKey(row.member_id, row.work_date)));\n',
    '    const savedScheduleKeys = new Set([\n      ...scheduleRows.map((row) => makeScheduleEntryKey(row.member_id, row.work_date)),\n      ...preservedScheduleKeys\n    ]);\n',
    "merge preserved schedule keys"
)

path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
print("patched web-api.js")
